read.en: Palantir fell 2.1% on Nov 13 to $167.99, trading $164.75–172.28 on light volume (0.59x the 20-day average). It is below the 5-day ($170.0, rising), 10-day ($169.1) and 30-day ($187.9), both falling, and above the 100-day ($166.7) and 200-day ($153.7), both rising. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 16, below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 11 ($153.50), and RSI is 39.5.
read.zh: Palantir 11月13日下跌 2.1%，收于 $167.99，盘中区间 $164.75–172.28，成交量偏低（20 日均量的 0.59 倍）。股价位于 5 日（$170.0，上行）、10 日（$169.1）和 30 日均线（$187.9）下方，后二者在下行；位于 100 日（$166.7）和 200 日均线（$153.7）上方，二者均在上行。MACD 自 10月16日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 11月11日起看多（$153.50），RSI 为 39.5。

read.en: The close lost the $168.3–170.8 band (5 and 10-day, Nov 11–12 lows), now resistance, but the $164.75 low held the 100-day zone. Resistance is $169.1–170.8, then $172.3–175.4 (Nov 11–13 highs) and $176.5–178.3. Support is $164–166.7 (100-day, Sep 10 and Nov 10 lows), then $157.2 (Nov 6 low) and $153.5–153.7 (SAR, 200-day). A close above $170.8 would target $173–175.4; below $164, $157.
